name: wellbeing-browser-1

notes.note: Proof of concept. This repo is a public fork of ungoogled-software/ungoogled-chromium, not a wrapper and not an extension. Our change is a GNU Quilt patch series compiled into the browser. Chromium source is downloaded at build time. extra/ patches can break on the next Chromium update. Building the browser needs depot_tools, a large checkout, and a long compile.

Feed-blocker policy, compiled into the browser from src/. BSD-3-Clause, with a copyright line for this project. Keep the upstream LICENSE and copyright notices. Do not use the Chrome trademark or re-enable Google telemetry. The build copies this tree into Chromium before compile.

notes.name: MatchesFeed
notes.note: True only for a recommended-video sidebar, discovery grid, or infinite-scroll continuation. False for the search box, masthead, player, primary navigation, and the video the user opened.

notes.name: BlockFeed
notes.note: Remove matched nodes before they paint. Do not cancel search, history navigation, or playback of the opened video.

notes.name: kYouTubeHosts
notes.note: YouTube host patterns only. Other platforms stay out of this proof of concept.

notes.name: kFeedSelectors
notes.note: Recommendation sidebar, related and end-screen grids, and the infinite-scroll continuation.

notes.name: kProtectedSelectors
notes.note: Search, masthead, player, and primary navigation. These stay even when they sit next to a recommendation region.

Unified diff that registers the feed-blocker sources and runs the agent at document start. The agent C++ lives in src/chrome/renderer/sedo and is copied in at build time. Register this patch in patches/series.

notes.name: OnDomUpdated
notes.note: Call FeedBlocker again when infinite scroll inserts nodes.

steps: Fork ungoogled-software/ungoogled-chromium into this repo and keep the fork open source
Keep the feed-blocker C++ in src/ and the renderer hook under patches/extra/sedo
Build the browser and block YouTube recommendation surfaces while search and direct navigation stay usable
